Dim workbook, sheet, values, rows, r, c, nonempty, fields(3), value
Dim path, lastRow, digits, padWidth, padB, padC
path = \"%CopiedFiles[0].FullName%\"
lastRow = CLng(%FirstFreeRow%) - 1
If lastRow < 2 Then Err.Raise 513, \"FLOW3\", \"Invalid range\"

\' Bind the workbook opened by PAD, never the arbitrary active workbook.
Set workbook = GetObject(path)
If LCase(workbook.FullName) <> LCase(path) Then Err.Raise 514, \"FLOW3\", \"Workbook mismatch\"
Set sheet = workbook.ActiveSheet
\' One bulk COM read; blank-row checks run on the in-memory array.
values = sheet.Range(\"A2:D\" & lastRow).Value2
\' Two more bulk reads for the zero-pad formats of B and C, so the row loop
\' never touches COM. A mixed format reads back as Null: raise rather than
\' guess, and let the native reader take over.
padB = ZeroPadWidth(sheet.Range(\"B2:B\" & lastRow).NumberFormat)
padC = ZeroPadWidth(sheet.Range(\"C2:C\" & lastRow).NumberFormat)
Set digits = New RegExp
digits.Pattern = \"^[0-9]+$\"
digits.Global = False
ReDim rows(UBound(values, 1))
rows(0) = \"A,B,C,D\"
Dim count
count = 0
For r = 1 To UBound(values, 1)
    nonempty = False
    For c = 1 To 4
        If IsError(values(r, c)) Then Err.Raise 515, \"FLOW3\", \"Excel cell error; use native reader\"
        If Not IsEmpty(values(r, c)) And Not IsNull(values(r, c)) Then
            If CStr(values(r, c)) <> \"\" Then nonempty = True
        End If
    Next
    If nonempty Then
        For c = 1 To 4
            value = values(r, c)
            If IsEmpty(value) Or IsNull(value) Then
                value = \"\"
            ElseIf VarType(value) = vbString Then
                value = CStr(value)
            Else
                \' Restore the leading zeros the cell format shows, from the
                \' format read once above. Reading .Text per cell would be a
                \' COM round trip per row and would follow the column width.
                value = CStr(value)
                padWidth = 0
                If c = 2 Then padWidth = padB
                If c = 3 Then padWidth = padC
                If padWidth > Len(value) And digits.Test(value) Then
                    value = String(padWidth - Len(value), \"0\") & value
                End If
            End If
            fields(c - 1) = CsvField(value)
        Next
        count = count + 1
        rows(count) = Join(fields, \",\")
    End If
Next
ReDim Preserve rows(count)
\' Emit only after the whole read succeeds: never return partial student data.
WScript.Echo Join(rows, vbCrLf)
Set sheet = Nothing
Set workbook = Nothing

Function CsvField(text)
    CsvField = Chr(34) & Replace(text, Chr(34), Chr(34) & Chr(34)) & Chr(34)
End Function

Function ZeroPadWidth(cellFormat)
    Dim probe
    ZeroPadWidth = 0
    If IsNull(cellFormat) Then Err.Raise 516, \"FLOW3\", \"Mixed number formats; use native reader\"
    probe = CStr(cellFormat)
    If Len(probe) > 0 And probe = String(Len(probe), \"0\") Then ZeroPadWidth = Len(probe)
End Function

    ELSE

    END

    LOOP FOREACH CurrentBatchFolder IN BatchFolders
        Text.ParseText.RegexParseForFirstOccurrence Text: CurrentBatchFolder.Name TextToFind: $'''^\\d{3}-[12](?:\\(\\d+\\))?$''' StartingPosition: 0 IgnoreCase: False OccurrencePosition=> BatchFolderNamePosition Match=> BatchFolderNameMatch

            NEXT LOOP

        Folder.GetFiles Folder: CurrentBatchFolder FileFilter: $'''*.pdf''' IncludeSubfolders: False FailOnAccessDenied: True SortBy1: Folder.SortBy.Name SortDescending1: False SortBy2: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending2: False SortBy3: Folder.SortBy.NoSort SortDescending3: False Files=> BatchPdfFiles
        IF BatchPdfFiles.Count = 0 THEN
            File.WriteText File: $'''%FolderPathLog%empty_batch.log''' TextToWrite: $'''[SKIP] ชุด %CurrentTermFolder.Name%\\%CurrentBatchFolder.Name% ไม่มีไฟล์ PDF''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
            NEXT LOOP
        END

            NEXT LOOP
        END
